أعتطف (form VIII)
# أَعْتَطِفُ (ʔaʕtaṭifu) /ʔaʕ.ta.tˤi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# أُعْتَطَفُ (ʔuʕtaṭafu) /ʔuʕ.ta.tˤa.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# أَعْتَطِفَ (ʔaʕtaṭifa) /ʔaʕ.ta.tˤi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# أُعْتَطَفَ (ʔuʕtaṭafa) /ʔuʕ.ta
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
